Bug_Title: TQ: Value that might carry a type qualifier is always used in a way prohibits it from having that type qualifier (TQ_MAYBE_SOURCE_VALUE_REACHES_NEVER_SINK)
Bug_Details:
A value that is annotated as possibly being an instance of
the values denoted by the type qualifier, and the value is guaranteed to be used
in a way that prohibits values denoted by that type qualifier.
Bug_Explanation: The input value is annotated with a custom '@PossiblySource' annotation to simulate a type qualifier. Despite this, the input is directly added to a list that only accepts non-qualified (safe) values, which violates the intended use of the type qualifier.
Trigger_Explanation: The JUnit test case triggers the bug by passing a string annotated with @PossiblySource to the showBug method. The method adds this input directly to a list that should only accept safe values, violating the intended use of the type qualifier. The test fails by asserting null on a non-null element, demonstrating the improper handling of the qualified value.
